Name: WORLD_MAP_POINT_PARAM_ST
Description: A point on the world map: a pin with an icon and up to 8 texts (place or NPC names). Rows are also the targets of MSB map-point regions (entering one sets the area name and the BGM) and of the event command that opens a map point.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Marks rows left out of the Network Test build. Appears unused by the game (retail rows with it set work normally).
Padding.
Padding.

Fields.Name: Open Event Flag ID
Fields.Description: The point is shown on the map while this event flag is on. The event command that opens a map point turns this flag on. 0: always open. The point also counts as open while its Distant View event flag is on. Retail: 6001 on points that are open from the start.

Fields.Name: Distant View Event Flag ID
Fields.Description: Turned on when the point is discovered as a distant-view mark (seen from afar). While it's on, the point counts as open even if its Open flag is off, and shows the Distant View icon instead of the normal one. 0: none. Unused in retail.

Fields.Name: Icon ID
Fields.Description: The map icon of the point. Replaced by the NPC icon while a visible text is an NPC name, and by the Distant View icon while the point is open only through its Distant View flag.

Fields.Name: BGM Place Type
Fields.Description: When the player enters this point's area (an MSB map-point region), the background music switches to this place type. 999: no change (most retail rows).

Fields.Name: Is Area Icon
Fields.Description: The icon marks an area rather than a spot: it's drawn in the map's area-icon layer, and the point is shown even without visible text. Unused in retail.

Fields.Name: Override Distant View Mark Position
Fields.Description: If set, the distant-view mark is placed at the Distant View Marker map and coordinates instead of the point's own map and position. Unused in retail.

Fields.Name: Show Without Text
Fields.Description: Shows the point even when none of its texts is visible. Without this (or Is Area Icon), a point is only shown while at least one text passes its flag checks.
Padding.

Fields.Name: Distant View Marker - Map Area
Fields.Description: AA part of the mAA_BB_CC_00 map of the distant-view mark. Used only when Override Distant View Mark Position is set.

Fields.Name: Distant View Marker - Map Block X
Fields.Description: BB part of the mAA_BB_CC_00 map of the distant-view mark. Used only when Override Distant View Mark Position is set.

Fields.Name: Distant View Marker - Map Block Z
Fields.Description: CC part of the mAA_BB_CC_00 map of the distant-view mark. Used only when Override Distant View Mark Position is set.

Fields.Name: Cleared Event Flag ID
Fields.Description: While this event flag is on, the pin shows its "cleared" mark. 0: never shows it. Unused in retail.

Fields.Name: Show on Lands Between Map (M00)
Fields.Description: The point appears on the surface world map (M00).

Fields.Name: Show on Underground Map (M01)
Fields.Description: The point appears on the underground map (M01).
Padding.

Fields.Name: Show on Land of Shadow Map (M10)
Fields.Description: The point appears on the Land of Shadow map (M10).
Padding.
Padding.

Fields.Name: Distant View Icon ID
Fields.Description: Icon shown instead of Icon ID while the point is open only through its Distant View event flag (its Open flag is still off). Unused in retail.

Fields.Name: Icon Angle
Fields.Description: Rotation of the icon on the map, in degrees.

Fields.Name: Map Area
Fields.Description: AA part of the mAA_BB_CC_00 map the position is relative to (60 for the Lands Between overworld, 61 for the Land of Shadow).

Fields.Name: Map Block X
Fields.Description: BB part of the mAA_BB_CC_00 map the position is relative to.

Fields.Name: Map Block Z
Fields.Description: CC part of the mAA_BB_CC_00 map the position is relative to.
Padding.

Fields.Name: Position X
Fields.Description: X coordinate of the point, relative to the map set by Map Area / Block X / Block Z. Places the pin on the world map, and is the distant-view mark position unless that is overridden.

Fields.Name: Position Y
Fields.Description: Y (height) coordinate of the point, relative to its map. Read together with X and Z when the position is converted; the world map itself is top-down.

Fields.Name: Position Z
Fields.Description: Z coordinate of the point, relative to the map set by Map Area / Block X / Block Z. Places the pin on the world map, and is the distant-view mark position unless that is overridden.

Fields.Name: Text ID 1
Fields.Description: Text shown with the point: a Place Name or NPC Name entry, picked by Text Type 1. -1: none. The text is visible while all its set Enable flags are on and not all of its set Disable flags are on. A point without any visible text is hidden, unless Show Without Text or Is Area Icon is set.

Fields.Name: Text 1 Enable Flag ID
Fields.Description: Text 1 is shown only while this event flag is on. Combined with Text 1 Enable Flag ID 2: every set flag must be on. 0: no condition.

Fields.Name: Text 1 Disable Flag ID
Fields.Description: Text 1 is hidden while this event flag is on, overriding the Enable flags. Combined with Text 1 Disable Flag ID 2: the text is hidden only when every set Disable flag is on. 0: no condition.

Fields.Name: Distant View ID 1
Fields.Description: The point becomes a distant-view mark while this distant view is active. Any of the four Distant View IDs can match. -1: none. Unused in retail.

Fields.Name: Distant View Marker - Position X
Fields.Description: X coordinate of the distant-view mark, relative to the Distant View Marker map. Used only when Override Distant View Mark Position is set.

Fields.Name: Distant View ID 3
Fields.Description: Another distant view that makes the point a distant-view mark. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Distant View ID 4
Fields.Description: Another distant view that makes the point a distant-view mark. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Display Min Zoom Step
Fields.Description: The point is drawn only when the map zoom step is at least this (0 is fully zoomed out, +1 per zoom level). 0: always drawn.

Fields.Name: Selection Min Zoom Step
Fields.Description: The point can be selected only when the map zoom step is at least this (0 is fully zoomed out, +1 per zoom level). Retail: 1 on every row.

Fields.Name: Area Name Priority
Fields.Description: When the player stands in several map-point regions at once, the point with the lowest value (0 before 1) supplies the current area name: its Text ID 1 (which must be set). Values above 1 are never picked. Retail uses 0 and 1.
